title: Stable growing-depth Bellman state
statement: Assuming a valid W4 bridge, identify a finite or monotone anisotropic state whose constants remain dimension-uniform through a prefix of linear depth.

signature.representation: General-t Schur recursion with recoverable directional coefficients and aggregate defects
signature.state_or_invariant: A closed cone of inverse floor, anisotropic surplus, and a controlled outer-defect budget
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The state is closed under every Bellman lift up to half depth without an O(n) deterioration of its coefficient.
information_discarded: individual permutation trajectories after conditional averaging
signature.target_implication: A stable state through ceil(n/2) prefixes yields C051; the separate C051-to-C050 transfer closes the Bellman path to L0.
signature.known_failure_mode: A new state may close W4 but accumulate a factor n or grow in dimension at each subsequent lift.
signature.verifier_class: symbolic recurrence closure plus adversarial coefficient-growth audit
